[SWS_Pwm_00158] ⌈After preparation for a power state is achieved by
([SWS_Pwm_00157]) then the API Pwm_SetPowerState  shall be  used to achieve
the requested power state of the Pwm module.
In order to avoid incoherent power state conditions, some APIs
(Pwm_SetPowerState, Pwm_PreparePowerState) have to be called in a given
sequence, otherwise an error (if DET tracing is enabled) is stored and the action is
interrupted. The Pwm Driver keeps track of the call sequence.⌋()
